36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daley Blind (Girona) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

34' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Filip Jorgensen to get hold of the ball.
